emote.name: Al kharid headbang
emote.clue: Headbang in the mine north of Al Kharid. Equip a desert shirt, leather gloves and leather boots.

emote.name: Ardgoune mill clap
emote.clue: Clap on the top level of the mill, north of East Ardougne. Equip a blue gnome robe top, HAM robe bottom and an unenchanted tiara.

emote.name: Beehive jump
emote.clue: Jump for joy at the beehives. Equip a desert shirt, green gnome robe bottoms and a steel axe.

emote.name: Draynor cross dance
emote.clue: Dance at the crossroads north of Draynor. Equip an iron chain body, a sapphire ring and a longbow.

emote.name: Draynor manor spin
emote.clue: Spin in the Draynor Manor by the fountain. Equip an iron platebody, studded leather chaps and a bronze full helmet.

emote.name: Draynor market yawn
emote.clue: Yawn in Draynor Marketplace. Equip studded leather chaps, an iron kiteshield and a steel longsword.

emote.name: Druid circle cheer
emote.clue: Cheer at the Druids' Circle. Equip a blue wizard hat, a bronze two-handed sword and HAM boots.

emote.name: Exam room clap
emote.clue: Clap in the main exam room in the Exam Centre. Equip a white apron, green gnome boots and leather gloves.

emote.name: Fally gem wave
emote.clue: Wave in the Falador gem store. Equip a Mithril pickaxe, Black platebody and an Iron Kiteshield.

emote.name: Fally party dance
emote.clue: Dance in the Party Room. Equip a steel full helmet, steel platebody and an iron plateskirt.

emote.name: Fish guild jig
emote.clue: Dance a jig by the entrance to the Fishing Guild. Equip an emerald ring, a sapphire amulet, and a bronze chain body.

emote.name: Fish trawler panic
emote.clue: Panic on the pier where you catch the Fishing trawler. Have nothing equipped at all when you do.

emote.name: Games room cheer
emote.clue: Cheer at the games room. Have nothing equipped at all when you do.

emote.name: Keep le faye
emote.clue: Blow raspberries out the entrance to Keep Le Faye. Equip a coif, an iron platebody and leather gloves.

emote.name: Legends guild
emote.clue: Bow outside the entrance to the Legends' Guild. Equip iron platelegs, an emerald amulet and an oak longbow.

emote.name: Limestone mine panic
emote.clue: Panic in the Limestone Mine. Equip bronze platelegs, a steel pickaxe and a steel medium helmet.

emote.name: Lumb shack dance
emote.clue: Dance in the shack in Lumbridge Swamp. Equip a bronze dagger, iron full helmet and a gold ring.

emote.name: Lumb wheat think
emote.clue: Think in middle of the wheat field by the lumbridge mill. Equip a blue gnome robetop, a turquoise gnome robe bottom and an oak shortbow.

emote.name: Lumber wave
emote.clue: Wave along the south fence of the Lumber Yard. Equip a hard leather body, leather chaps and a bronze axe.

emote.name: Monkey cage
emote.clue: Blow a raspberry at the monkey cage in Ardougne Zoo. Equip a studded leather body, bronze platelegs and a normal staff with no orb.

emote.name: Mudskipper wave
emote.clue: Wave on Mudskipper Point. Equip a black cape, leather chaps and a steel mace.

emote.name: Rimmington cross spin
emote.clue: Spin at the crossroads north of Rimmington. Equip a green gnome hat, cream gnome top and leather chaps.

emote.name: Rimmington shrug
emote.clue: Shrug in the mine near Rimmington. Equip a gold necklace, a gold ring and a bronze spear.

emote.name: Varrock court spin
emote.clue: Spin in the Varrock Castle courtyard. Equip a black axe, a coif and a ruby ring.

emote.name: Varrock library yawn
emote.clue: Yawn in the Varrock library. Equip a green gnome robe top, HAM robe bottom and an iron warhammer.

emote.name: Wizard tower clap
emote.clue: Clap on the causeway to the Wizards' Tower. Equip an iron medium helmet, emerald ring and a white apron.

emote.name: Barb agility cheer
emote.clue: Cheer in the Barbarian Agility Arena. Headbang before you talk to me. Equip a steel plate body, maple shortbow, and a wilderness cape.

emote.name: Barb bridge spin
emote.clue: Spin on the bridge by the Barbarian Village. Salute before you talk to me. Equip purple gloves, a steel kiteshield and a mithril full helmet.

emote.name: Castle wars yawn
emote.clue: Yawn in the Castle Wars lobby. Shrug before you talk to me. Equip ruby amulet, a mithril scimitar and a Wilderness cape.

emote.name: Catherby range cry
emote.clue: Cry in the Catherby Ranging shop. Bow before you talk to me. Equip blue gnome boots, a hard leather body and an unblessed silver sickle.

emote.name: Catherby shore cry
emote.clue: Cry on the shore of Catherby beach. Laugh before you talk to me. Equip an adamant sq shield, a bone dagger and mithril platebody.

emote.name: Catherby shrug
emote.clue: Shrug in Catherby bank. Yawn before you talk to me. Equip a maple longbow, green d'hide chaps and an iron med helm.

emote.name: Digsite beckon
emote.clue: Beckon in the Digsite, near the eastern winch. Bow or curtsy before you talk to me. Equip a green gnome hat, snakeskin boots and an iron pickaxe.

emote.name: Edge gen cheer
emote.clue: Cheer in the Edgeville general store. Dance before you talk to me. Equip a brown apron, leather boots and leather gloves.

emote.name: Lumb cave dance
emote.clue: Dance in the dark cave beneath Lumbridge Swamp. Blow a kiss before you talk to me. Equip an air staff, bronze full helm and an amulet of power.

emote.name: Observatory think
emote.clue: Think in the centre of the Observatory. Spin before you talk to me. Equip a mithril chain body, green dragonhide chaps and a ruby amulet.

emote.name: Ogre pen cheer
emote.clue: Cheer in the Ogre Pen in the Training Camp. Show you are angry before you talk to me. Equip a green dragonhide body and chaps and a steel square shield.

emote.name: Seers court clap
emote.clue: Clap in Seers court house. Spin before you talk to me. Equip an adamant halberd, blue mystic robe bottom and a diamond ring.

emote.name: Shantay guild jig
emote.clue: Dance a jig under Shantay's Awning. Bow before you talk to me. Equip a pointed blue snail helmet, an air staff and a bronze square shield.

emote.name: Tai bwo beckon
emote.clue: Beckon in Tai Bwo Wannai. Clap before you talk to me. Equip green dragonhide chaps, a ring of dueling and a mithril medium helmet.

emote.name: Tzhaar jump
emote.clue: Jump for joy in the TzHaar sword shop. Shrug before you talk to me. Equip a Steel longsword, Blue D'hide body and blue mystic gloves.

emote.name: Yanille jump
emote.clue: Jump for joy in Yanille bank. Dance a jig before you talk to me. Equip a brown apron, adamantite medium helmet and snakeskin chaps.

emote.name: Banana salute
emote.clue: Salute in the banana plantation. Beware of double agents! Equip a diamond ring, amulet of power, and nothing on your chest or legs.

emote.name: Cat entrance dance
emote.clue: Dance at the cat doored pyramid in Sophanem. Beware of double agents! Equip a ring of life an uncharged amulet of glory and an adamant two handed sword.

emote.name: Fishing guild blow
emote.clue: Blow a raspberry in the Fishing Guild bank. Beware of double agents! Equip an elemental shield, blue dragonhide chaps and a rune warhammer.

emote.name: Jokul tent laugh
emote.clue: Laugh in the Jokul's tent in the Mountain Camp. Beware of double agents! Equip a rune full helmet, blue dragonhide chaps and a fire battlestaff.

emote.name: Rogue gen yawn
emote.clue: Yawn in the rogues' general store. Beware of double agents! Equip an adamant square shield, blue dragon vambraces and a rune pickaxe.

emote.name: Shilo kiss
emote.clue: Blow a kiss between the tables in Shilo Village bank. Beware of double agents! Equip a blue mystic hat, bone spear and rune plate body.

emote.name: Zammy altar shrug
emote.clue: Shrug in the Zamorak temple found in the Eastern Wilderness. Beware of double agents! Equip rune plate legs, an iron platebody and blue dragonhide vambraces.
